rebindings.note: Full saved page and complete amended original017 line31 record independently reread after both owner amendments; actual ABC163/Ebertin235/Sandbach81–82 and retained Witte209/Munkasey265 checked here.

limitations: The Jupiter/MC=Chiron path declares no currently ingested activation paragraph; this is checked against its complete original/current page, not asserted as an exhaustive absence in Sandbach or another raw work.
Locator-only approvals do not endorse inherited prose as a fresh translation or silently rewrite source-native grammar. All added references were independently checked on actual raw pages.
The canonical Ober PDF is outside the Vault and protected baseline. It was read only, and its preinspection/postinspection SHA256 matches. It is not counted among five protected Vault PDFs.
Printed and one-based PDF pages remain distinct. Witte217,300,83,166 PDF-only references make no unsupported printed-page claim.
